data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elijah total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Eliyyahu: Eli, 'my God', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-h-w. The prophet Elijah (1 Kings 17). Elijah is a Hebrew name meaning “My God is Yahweh”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
